scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode preact && node scripts/package-html.mjs dist
scripts.build:react: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production --outDir dist-react && node scripts/package-html.mjs dist-react
scripts.build:preact: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode preact --outDir dist-preact && node scripts/package-html.mjs dist-preact
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages --outDir dist-pages && node scripts/package-html.mjs dist-pages
scripts.build:pages:test: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages-test --outDir dist-pages-test && node scripts/package-html.mjs dist-pages-test
